# 4 bed cottage for sale

> Ballintubbert is a charming 4 Bedroom Bungalow, located along the Ballintubbert Road just off the N80 in a Peaceful Rural Location Between Stradbally & Athy Town. Sitting on its own spacious site of C. 0.49 acres / 0.20 hectares and surrounded by panoramic views of the countryside. Comprising C. 117 sq. m of internal living space.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed

- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: Ballintubbert, Athy
